Klaude lockscreen quote collection

Source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/geosfero/positivequotation-public-domain-quotes
Pinned revision: 4c8151903a29476f8fc66b26237c5911e1199835
data.json SHA-256: f9e8db216cc7e83dbb21dc24735d2d828a6047c709381ed4240e5e049e2bd7c4

19 unmodified English proverbs selected from the 30 reviewed records.
Every selected row retains all original attribution and provenance fields.
Separately, 130 local Easter eggs include user supplied lines and
44 original Klaude microcopy lines. They are not dataset records or
attributed to any game, film, artist or meme creator. No third-party
assets are included. All entries and their origin metadata are stored in
lockscreen-quotes.json.
Thomas Preston is the source compiler, not the author of these proverbs.
Hugging Face license metadata is 'other'. The upstream LICENSE file is
empty; this collection does not claim CC0 or a universal public-domain
license. The source edition is marked public domain in the USA.
The fallback 'Make a little room for a new idea.' is original Klaude copy
under Klaude's MIT license; it is not part of the source collection.

Dataset card: https://huggingface.co/datasets/geosfero/positivequotation-public-domain-quotes/blob/4c8151903a29476f8fc66b26237c5911e1199835/README.md
Dataset card SHA-256: df6dc3cec4e1e1f849341e8c6759d78f0aae77d8e9d1d70c7863cfccdf424b12

The dataset card requests that attribution, source entry numbers and
source URLs be retained for provenance. These fields are preserved in
lockscreen-quotes.json and its bundled copy. The quote container retains
attribution in an accessible, visually hidden cite element, source title
and entry in its tooltip, and source URL in its cite attribute.

Book: A Dictionary of English Proverbs and Proverbial Phrases
Compiler: Thomas Preston
Source catalog: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/39281
Source edition status: Public domain in the USA. Other jurisdictions
and rights may differ; the dataset does not claim a universal license.
Only the underlying proverb text and factual provenance are included;
the Gutenberg eBook, trademarked wrapper and dataset card are not copied.
